rules.name: topUp_closed
rules.why: closed deposits cannot be topped up

rules.name: extend_not_earlier

params.forbidden: arg(1) <= pre("deposits", arg(0), "unlockAt") or arg(1) > now + 31536000

rules.why: extend only later, at most MAX_DELAY ahead

rules.name: move_only_owner
rules.why: only owner moves ownership, never to zero

rules.name: totalLocked_eth_sync
rules.why: booked total moves with held ETH

rules.name: unlock_never_earlier
rules.expr: ok and pre("deposits", arg(0), "amount") > 0 and post("deposits", arg(0), "unlockAt") < pre("deposits", arg(0), "unlockAt")

rules.name: deposit_record
rules.expr: ok and called("deposit") and (post("deposits", pre("nextId"), "owner") != sender or post("deposits", pre("nextId"), "amount") != post("ETH", A0) - pre("ETH", A0) or post("deposits", pre("nextId"), "unlockAt") != now + arg(0))
rules.why: deposit records caller, value and unlock time

rules.name: topUp_sync
rules.expr: ok and called("topUp") and post("deposits", arg(0), "amount") - pre("deposits", arg(0), "amount") != post("totalLocked") - pre("totalLocked")
rules.why: topUp adds same to deposit and total

rules.name: withdraw_zeroes
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and post("deposits", arg(0), "amount") != 0

rules.name: extend_no_side_effect
rules.expr: ok and called("extend") and (post("deposits", arg(0), "amount") != pre("deposits", arg(0), "amount") or post("deposits", arg(0), "owner") != pre("deposits", arg(0), "owner") or post("totalLocked") != pre("totalLocked"))

rules.name: move_no_side_effect
rules.expr: ok and called("moveOwnership") and (post("deposits", arg(0), "amount") != pre("deposits", arg(0), "amount") or post("deposits", arg(0), "unlockAt") != pre("deposits", arg(0), "unlockAt") or post("totalLocked") != pre("totalLocked"))

rules.name: eth_out_only_withdraw
rules.expr: ok and post("ETH", A0) < pre("ETH", A0) and not called("withdraw")

rules.name: withdraw_pays_at_most_amount
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and pre("ETH", A0) - post("ETH", A0) > pre("totalLocked") - post("totalLocked")
rules.why: ETH paid out never exceeds the booked decrease; comparing with a single deposit's amount false-alarms when the U1 callback legitimately withdraws a second deposit it owns

params.condition: sender == U0 and sender == pre("deposits", arg(0), "owner") and now >= pre("deposits", arg(0), "unlockAt") and pre("deposits", arg(0), "amount") > 0

rules.name: withdraw_pays_owner_exact
rules.expr: ok and called("withdraw") and sender == U0 and post("ETH", sender) - pre("ETH", sender) != pre("deposits", arg(0), "amount")
rules.why: a withdrawing (non-callback) owner receives exactly the deposit amount

rules.name: owner_changes_only_via_move
rules.expr: ok and not called("moveOwnership") and pre("deposits", arg(0), "owner") != 0 and post("deposits", arg(0), "owner") != pre("deposits", arg(0), "owner")
rules.why: an existing deposit's owner changes only through moveOwnership
